implementation_tasks.name: Project scaffold: Next.js 14 + TS strict + Tailwind + Zustand + Dexie + Recharts + Framer Motion + Vitest
Define core type system aligned with API spec schemas
Implement Dexie database layer with sessions/hands tables
Implement deck shuffle (Fisher-Yates + crypto.getRandomValues) and deal
Implement hand evaluator with lookup-table optimization
Implement game state machine: betting rounds, legal actions, street progression
Implement pot calculator with side pot handling
Implement showdown resolution and chip settlement
Poker engine unit tests for core scenarios
Build GTO preflop strategy dataset (6 positions × 4 scenarios)
Build GTO postflop strategy dataset (7 scenarios × position × street)
Implement GTO provider with lazy loading
Define BOT style profiles and hand range tables
Implement BOT decision engine with decision tree framework
Validate BOT personality behaviors with behavioral tests
Implement GameService: orchestrate deal → actions → BOT → showdown flow
Implement SessionService: CRUD + status transitions + chip init
Implement shared UI components: AppShell, TopNav, Modal, Toast, Skeleton, EmptyState
Implement PlayingCard component with flip animation
Implement PokerTable + PlayerSeat with 6-seat elliptical layout
Implement CommunityCards + PotDisplay + DealerButton
Implement ActionPanel + RaiseSlider with validation and quick-amount buttons
Implement GameTable container + useGame hook integrating all game components
Implement game animations: deal, chips, community cards, winner highlight
Implement ShowdownOverlay + BetTimeline
Implement BOT think animation with sequential action playback
Implement HomePage + QuickStartPanel + RecentSessionCard + SessionConfigModal
Implement SessionPauseModal + SessionSummaryModal + SessionProfitChart
Implement HandHistoryService: auto-save on hand end + scenario tag generation
Implement hand history UI: list, card, filter, scenario tags
Implement GTO evaluator: player vs GTO comparison with deviation severity
Implement EV calculator: lookup-based EV + EV loss computation
Implement ReplayService: build DecisionPoints + TableSnapshots from hand data
Implement replay UI core: HandReplayView + ReplayTableSnapshot + DecisionPointPanel
Implement GTO comparison components: GTOFrequencyChart + DeviationBadge + EVAnalysisCard
Implement replay navigation: NavBar + StreetJumpNav + DecisionTimeline + keyboard shortcuts + auto-play
Implement HandSummaryFooter with total EV loss and key deviation list
Implement StatsService: aggregate by position/street/scenario with GTO comparison
Implement stats dashboard UI: StatsDashboard + TimeRangeSelector + OverviewStatsCards
Implement stats charts: PositionStatsChart + StreetStatsChart + ScenarioRadarChart
Implement DrilldownPanel for scenario-level hand list exploration
Implement export service: HH text formatter + JSON export + browser download
Implement export UI: ExportModal + ExportButton
Implement session pause/resume persistence and browser reopen recovery
Implement global error handling: IndexedDB detection, Toast warnings, engine error Modal
E2E integration tests: full game flow → save → replay → stats update
